title: Shared register line
description: One line of a product's register: open questions, assumptions, blockers and decisions. JSON Lines, UTF-8, append-only, one object per line, stored in the product folder (default .po/register.jsonl). Never edit or delete a line; a change of state is a new update line. One taxonomy with ai-sdlc-loop's shared surface register (DEC-002 in docs/decisions.md): the baseline is the register section of ai-sdlc-loop's data/agent-contract.json, and everything aidev-po adds is the optional aidev-po extension, marked x-extension below, which ai-sdlc-loop's checker accepts too. So a register can be handed to ai-sdlc-loop and back, and both checkers pass it. Validate each line against this schema.

phase.description: The part of the work the line belongs to. aidev-po writes its stage here, as the lower-case stage name: idea, audience, actors, systems, scope, workshops, presentations or fsd. ai-sdlc-loop writes its phase name (for example Plan or Build, or all on a coordinator update). Any non-empty string is valid, so lines from either tool pass.

status.description: Baseline: open: declared, not yet looked at. surfaced: put in front of the human. answered: the human answered, or confirmed or rejected the assumption. dismissed: settled from the evidence, reason in note. duplicate: same as the entry in ref. aidev-po extension: decided: a decision in force. superseded: a decision replaced by a later one, named in ref.

type.description: Baseline: assumption: decided without being able to confirm it. question: could not settle it, wants an answer, ideally with a recommended answer in text. blocker: stops the work, or stops it being done correctly, until resolved. aidev-po extension: decision: a choice made, by the user or by po on the user's behalf, including a user overruling the challenger; binding downstream. feedback: the user's feedback on an output (learning loop), full record in .po/feedback.jsonl, named in record. attribution: the tracer's finding for a feedback line, full record in .po/attributions.jsonl, named in record; answered with answer confirmed or rejected once the user has seen it.

record.description: aidev-po extension. For types feedback and attribution (required for them): the id of the full record.

text.description: One-line statement, verbatim from the agent's register request.

impact.description: What goes wrong if this is wrong.

urgency.description: How soon the human's view is needed.

item_ids.description: aidev-po extension. Stable IDs of the output items this entry is about (trace.schema.json).

ref.description: The id of the entry this line changes.

by.description: human is the person aidev-po calls the user.
